WYLDER-MAGMA_SHOT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply 2 [gold]Magma Burn[/gold]. [gold]Charged[/gold]: Consume 1 [gold]Charge[/gold], deal 4 additional damage, apply [gold]Magma Burn[/gold] to all enemies.
WYLDER-MANTLE_OF_THORNS.title: Mantle of Thorns
WYLDER-BRIARS_OF_SIN.title: Briars of Sin
WYLDER-BRIARS_OF_PUNISHMENT.title: Briars of Punishment
WYLDER-BRIARS_OF_PUNISHMENT.description: Lose 1 HP. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies 2 times. Apply {Damage:diff()}x2 [gold]Bleed[/gold]. [gold]Charged[/gold]: Consume 1 [gold]Charge[/gold], deal 7 damage and apply 7 [gold]Bleed[/gold] to all enemies again.
WYLDER-IMPENETRABLE_THORNS.title: Impenetrable Thorns
WYLDER-IMPENETRABLE_THORNS.description: For every 10 [gold]Block[/gold] you have, deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {blood:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold] to a random enemy 1 time.
WYLDER-GLINTSTONE_ICECRAG.title: Glintstone Icecrag
WYLDER-GLINTSTONE_ICECRAG.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {frost:diff()} Frost. [gold]Charged[/gold]: Apply {chargeFrost:diff()} additional Frost.
WYLDER-FREEZING_MIST.title: Freezing Mist
WYLDER-FREEZING_MIST.description: At the start of your turn, apply {frost:diff()} Frost to all enemies.
WYLDER-HONED_BOLT.title: Honed Bolt
WYLDER-HONED_BOLT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add a copy of this card to your hand with +{bonusDamage:diff()} damage and Ethereal.
WYLDER-LIGHTNING_STRIKE.title: Lightning Strike
WYLDER-LIGHTNING_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies in sequence. Draw 1 card each time damage is dealt.
WYLDER-KNIGHTS_LIGHTNING_SPEAR.title: Knight's Lightning Spear
WYLDER-KNIGHTS_LIGHTNING_SPEAR.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply a debuff: At the end of your turn, deal {spearDamage:diff()} Lightning damage for each card in your hand. [gold]Charged[/gold]: +3 damage per card. Removed after triggering.
WYLDER-DRAGONBOLT_BLESSING.title: Dragonbolt Blessing
WYLDER-DRAGONBOLT_BLESSING.description: Apply {lightning:diff()} Lightning Mark to all enemies. Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Reduce all damage taken by {reduce:diff()} this turn.
WYLDER-DEATH_RANCOR.title: Death Rancor
WYLDER-DEATH_RANCOR.description: Unplayable. When added to your hand: Exhaust this card, draw 1 card, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
WYLDER-ANCIENT_DEATH_OF_RANCOR.title: Ancient Death of Rancor
WYLDER-ANCIENT_DEATH_OF_RANCOR.descripti: Shuffle {count:diff()} Death Rancor into your draw pile and discard pile. [gold]Charged[/gold]: Shuffle {chargeCount:diff()} additional into each.
WYLDER-EXPLOSIVE_GHOSTFLAME.title: Explosive Ghostflame
WYLDER-EXPLOSIVE_GHOSTFLAME.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Apply {deathFlame:diff()} Death Flame. [gold]Charged[/gold]: Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
WYLDER-TIBIAS_SUMMONS.title: Tibia's Summons
WYLDER-TIBIAS_SUMMONS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {count:diff()} times. For each Death Rancor in your draw pile, shuffle a Death Rancor into your draw pile.
WYLDER-THE_FLAME_OF_FRENZY.title: The Flame of Frenzy
WYLDER-THE_FLAME_OF_FRENZY.description: Cost X. Deal {Damage:diff()} Fire damage to a random enemy X times (X+1 if upgraded). Add X Mad to discard pile (X+1 if upgraded).
WYLDER-FRENZIED_BURST.title: Frenzied Burst
WYLDER-FRENZIED_BURST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} Fire damage. Add {madCount:diff()} Mad to hand. Charged: Damage increased by {chargeBonus:diff()}.
WYLDER-ETERNAL_DARKNESS.title: Eternal Darkness
WYLDER-ETERNAL_DARKNESS.description: Gain an effect: For 2 turns, each card you generate is immediately exhausted, then you gain {block:diff()} Block.
WYLDER-ORIGIN_FORM.title: Origin Form
WYLDER-ORIGIN_FORM.description: Gain {amount:diff()} [gold]Origin Form[/gold]. Cards you generate during combat deal 2x damage and Block.
WYLDER-NIGHT_MAIDENS_MIST.title: Night Maiden's Mist
WYLDER-NIGHT_MAIDENS_MIST.description: Apply {amount:diff()} [gold]Night Maiden's Mist[/gold] to all enemies. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
WYLDER-STARS_OF_RUIN.title: Stars of Ruin
WYLDER-STARS_OF_RUIN.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} magic affinity damage {hitCount:diff()} times. [gold]Charged[/gold]: Consume 1 [gold]Charge[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} magic affinity damage {chargeHitCount:diff()} times instead.
WYLDER-UNSEEN_FORM.title: Unseen Form
WYLDER-AMBUSH_SHARD.title: Ambush Shard
WYLDER-NIGHT_COMET.title: Night Comet
WYLDER-NIGHT_COMET.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} + target's Block magic affinity damage. [gold]Charged[/gold]: Consume 1 [gold]Charge[/gold], deal {chargeBonus:diff()} extra damage.
WYLDER-LITANY_OF_PROPER_DEATH.title: Litany of Proper Death
WYLDER-LITANY_OF_PROPER_DEATH.descriptio: All enemies lose {strLoss:diff()} Strength and gain {holy:diff()} stacks of [orange]Pure Holy[/orange]. If the enemy is a Minion, it also loses {minionHpLoss:diff()} HP.
WYLDER-RADAGONS_RINGS.title: Radagon's Rings
WYLDER-RADAGONS_RINGS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} holy affinity damage to all enemies {hitCount:diff()} times.
